summaryJa:
離陸と着陸: 機はOKASから011206ZDEC22に離陸し、020723ZDEC22に着陸。合計任務時間は19時間17分。ステーション滞在は約18時間35分（記録上のオンステーションは011220Z–020655Z）。
任務概要: 任務種別はISR（Operation INHERENT RESOLVE、発信部隊482ATKS）。事前調整は236分で「SATISFACTORY」。FMVはDGS‑ARで解析済み。
活動: 1323Z–0626Zにエアハンドラー経由でSIGINTを収集。1518Z–0426Zにターゲット開発/監視（POL／HVI/POIスキャン、装備・護送・人員のスキャン）を実施。0426Zにタスキング解除、RTB。
UAP報告: 011620Zに1機の可能性のあるUAP/UAVを38SMB4…付近で西→東へ観測。追跡は行わず任務継続。UAPのシグネチャーや人的影響の報告はなし。
summaryEn:
Flight and timing: Aircraft departed OKAS at 011206ZDEC22 and landed at 020723ZDEC22. Total mission time 19 hours 17 minutes. Time on station approximately 18 hours 35 minutes (recorded on‑station window 011220Z–020655Z).
Mission summary: ISR mission supporting Operation INHERENT RESOLVE, originator unit 482ATKS. Precoord was 236 minutes and assessed as satisfactory. FMV was exploited by DGS‑AR.
Activities: Collected SIGINT via airhandler from 1323Z–0626Z. Conducted target development/ISR (POL/HVI/POI scans, ADMS/suits, weapons, convoys/sentry, personnel) from 1518Z–0426Z. Cleared off tasking and RTB at 0426Z.
UAP: At 011620Z a single possible UAP/UAV was observed west‑to‑east near the referenced grid. The aircraft did not pursue it and continued the mission. No signatures or effects on personnel were reported.
